body.zh:
Gemini 4 Argon 使用同一型号 `gemini-4-argon` 调用原生同步与流式内容接口。

- 同步：`POST /v1beta/models/gemini-4-argon:generateContent`。
- 流式：`POST /v1beta/models/gemini-4-argon:streamGenerateContent?alt=sse`。
- 提交文字、PNG 单图或多图、MP4 视频与 PDF；同一用户消息可以包含完整视频和多张图片。
- 系统指令独立传入，支持结构化结果、低思考档与单轮函数调用请求。函数由调用方执行。
- 不把示例预算或短素材长度当作最大上限。
- 原生用量包含已报告的工具输入与思考；缓存为输入子集。自动切换服务线路不改变本模型的已公布售价。

详见[原生接口文档](/zh/api-reference/text-series/gemini/native-generate)和[流式接口文档](/zh/api-reference/text-series/gemini/native-stream)。
body.en:
Use Gemini 4 Argon under the single model ID `gemini-4-argon` with native synchronous and streaming content endpoints.

- Synchronous: `POST /v1beta/models/gemini-4-argon:generateContent`.
- Streaming: `POST /v1beta/models/gemini-4-argon:streamGenerateContent?alt=sse`.
- Submit text, one or more PNG images, MP4 video and PDF. One user message can combine the complete video and multiple images.
- Send system instructions separately; request structured output, low thinking effort or a single-turn function call. The client executes returned function calls.
- Example budgets and short fixtures do not establish service maxima.
- Native usage includes reported tool-use input and thinking; cache is an input subset. Automatic route changes retain the published price for this model.

See the [Native API Reference](/en/api-reference/text-series/gemini/native-generate) and [Streaming API Reference](/en/api-reference/text-series/gemini/native-stream).
